pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: lib/text/router.ts:314 The sole-entry-point rule is stated in prose with no negative-space gate behind it (no no-restricted rule in eslint.config.mjs, no matching check in pipeline gates or tests/next-gates), and it is already breached: lib/music-clip/gemini.ts:95 posts generateContent directly, outside the router's trail and spend booking.

techniques.evidence: lib/text/router.ts:314 No call-site tag bijection and no confinement rule for the vendor endpoint or provider modules; lib/sound/suno/listen.ts:31 and lib/foundry/scout/doctorOllama.ts:1 also import from provider modules.
lib/text/router.ts:1 The forbidden action simply works: lib/music-clip/gemini.ts:95 calls Gemini directly and nothing goes red.

lib/text/repair.ts:237 The repaired object re-enters the validator the model cannot write, after diff and no-shrink guards in code. Limit: a finding with path "" (lib/notebook/failure.ts:45) makes covers() license edits everywhere, leaving only no-shrink on scope.
lib/text/router.ts:425 A probe that cannot confirm an engine eliminates that candidate on the record; an empty chain ends in refusal, never a served answer.
lib/text/router.ts:684 .env.example is tracked and declares GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY (:205), OLLAMA_HOST (:323) and TEXT_RETRIEVE (:92), so the named remedy resolves in the shipped tree.
lib/text/router.ts:449 A vendor's native schema enforcement is not trusted; the door re-checks every served answer. Limit: the check is shallow by design (lib/text/json.ts:27).
pipeline/check-bundle.mjs:143 The seam's server-only claim is tested against emitted browser chunks, behind a positive control, not against source imports.
pipeline/check-bundle.mjs:141 Each lib/text fingerprint names its source file and is asserted present there with comments stripped, so a rewording exits 2.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:198 The escape hatch names only a version, so one press waives every blocking finding on it, and the frozen receipt (lib/script/versions.ts:136) keeps a count and render ids rather than each finding's rule and site.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:198 Fails the technique's own test: two blocking findings cannot be waived one at a time, because the op has no field for a finding. Mitigated, not cured, by the operator seeing the blocking render list (line 196).

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:161 The act that advances the version writes the override onto it (fixtureScript.ts accept-over-gate, overrideFrom), and the version rail keeps showing it.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Findings.tsx:13 Unmeasured and not-engaged render as their own verdicts, never as pass, and Document.tsx:258 counts unmeasured beside violations.
